svg.title: APEX 07 — Fifteen stages from awareness to expansion
svg.text: Fifteen stages from awareness to expansion
The enterprise funnel runs from market awareness to contract closure and on into onboarding, retention and
expansion. Each stage has one objective, the material it needs, the sales activity, the outcome and the metric we track.
The pivot of the funnel is the paid pilot (stage 9): everything before it earns the right to a pilot; everything
after it converts pilot evidence into a contract. Track conversion at every stage from the first deal.
Capability status shown on the poster where relevant
Readiness: capabilities marked LIVE are built and tested; none is yet proven in a customer production environment. No customer results, ROI, certifications or prices are claimed.
November 2026 · Internal sales enablement · A0 841 × 1189 mm
